method.capture: ChatCut web_browser (Firecrawl) on https://sixpeaks.games/ with a layout script; JPEG q95 full-page screenshot (PNG screenshots are 256-colour quantized and were rejected); crops via assets/raw/shots/<batch>/pos.json.
method.alpha: Difference matting of black-backed and white-backed copies: alpha = 1 - mean(W-B)/255, colour = B/alpha; values <0.035 -> 0, >0.975 -> 1. Small logos rendered at 2x/4x with image-rendering:pixelated and block-averaged back.
method.encoding: Photos WebP q82 method 6 (max 1920 wide; recipe caps captures at 1900 wide). Logos/icons lossless WebP with alpha. brand/logo-white.png and brand/mark.png are PNG.
